title: Post-research interview gate
summary: Run the interview only after proposal research, project-context retrieval, prior-art/best-practice lookup, and local artifact inspection leave genuinely user-owned decisions unresolved.

title: Hybrid interview artifact model
summary: Create interview.md plus interview.nodes.jsonl/interview.edges.jsonl, then copy or cite accepted decisions into requirements/design graph artifacts.

title: Bounded approval checkpoint
summary: End the interview with a compact decision summary and require user approval before requirements/design generation proceeds.

title: Optional preview-first mockup aid
summary: For UI-affecting interview questions, use lightweight preview artifacts such as generated single-file HTML and optional headless screenshots rather than a persistent editor.

title: Ask immediately after proposal
summary: Rejected because it would ask the user questions that code, documentation, prior art, or best practices could answer.

title: Store only separate interview artifacts
summary: Rejected because separate-only interview artifacts would make requirements/design less authoritative and force planning to inspect another artifact family for accepted behavior.

title: Store only requirements/design nodes
summary: Rejected because it loses the interview trail, recommendations, researched-but-not-asked questions, dependencies, and deferred decisions.

title: Build a persistent mockup editor first
summary: Rejected for v1 because it expands scope beyond mockups as decision aids for requirements clarification.
